gemini.prompt_template:
Today is {today}. I already have these AI/tech stories: {covered_summary}

Search for major AI news from today NOT already covered above. Focus on:
- model_releases: new AI model launches, version releases, benchmark results today
- funding: AI startup funding rounds, acquisitions, valuations today
- research_papers: notable AI research papers or findings published today
- ai_policy: AI regulation, government policy, safety announcements today

DO NOT include URLs. Return JSON with 4 keys, each 2-3 story objects (title, summary 2 sentences, source, date):
{"model_releases":[],"funding":[],"research_papers":[],"ai_policy":[]}
Return ONLY valid JSON.
